definitions.gloss: friendly relations; fellowship; cordiality; getting to know each other
definitions.explanation: Warm, cordial interaction aimed at building personal connections. Most commonly seen in compound forms like {懇親会|こんしんかい} (social gathering).

examples.japanese: {懇親会|こんしんかい}に{参加|さんか}する。
{懇親|こんしん}を{深|ふか}めるために{食事会|しょくじかい}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: We held a dinner party to deepen our friendly relations.

examples.japanese: {学会|がっかい}の{後|あと}、{参加者|さんかしゃ}どうしの{懇親|こんしん}を{図|はか}る{場|ば}が{設|もう}けられた。
examples.english: After the academic conference, an opportunity was set up for attendees to build friendly connections.

notes:
Most frequently encountered in the compound {懇親会|こんしんかい} (social gathering, mixer), which is a standard event in Japanese business, academic, and organizational life. These gatherings typically involve food and drinks and are designed for networking and relationship-building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懇親会|こんしんかい}: social gathering, mixer, reception
- {懇親|こんしん}を{深|ふか}める: to deepen friendly relations
- {懇親|こんしん}を{図|はか}る: to promote fellowship
- {懇親|こんしん}パーティー: friendship party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {親睦|しんぼく}: friendship, amity — very similar meaning; often interchangeable ({親睦会|しんぼくかい} is nearly synonymous with {懇親会|こんしんかい})
- {交流|こうりゅう}: exchange, interaction — broader and more neutral; covers cultural, academic, and international exchanges

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in business, academic, and organizational contexts. Not typically used in casual conversation.
